failedAssertions.reason: TPOT with MTP enabled (54.84ms) is 9.3% WORSE than non-MTP eager baseline (50.19ms). The assertion requires TPOT <= 100% of non-MTP TPOT (lower TPOT = better). MTP is incompatible with FULL_DECODE_ONLY HIP graph mode on MI100/gfx908 (RuntimeError during graph capture), forcing --enforce-eager fallback. In eager mode, graph optimizations are lost, and the draft model overhead is not compensated by the 85% acceptance rate. Best performance on MI100 is graph mode WITHOUT MTP (TPOT 14.17ms).

notes.graphModeMTPIncompatibility: MTP speculative decoding is fundamentally incompatible with FULL_DECODE_ONLY HIP graph mode on MI100/gfx908. When starting vLLM with both --compilation-config '{"cudagraph_mode":"FULL_DECODE_ONLY"}' and --speculative-config, the server crashes with RuntimeError during graph capture/warmup. The MTP feature works correctly in --enforce-eager mode.
notes.recommendation: MTP on MI100 should NOT be used in production. FULL_DECODE_ONLY graph mode (without MTP) provides +68-72% TPOT improvement. MTP eager mode provides -9.3% TPOT regression. The optimal config for MI100 remains graph mode + prefix caching from the graph-config milestone.
notes.crossMilestoneImpact: VAL-CROSS-001 (MTP + HIP graphs) is documented as incompatible. This will need to be addressed in combined optimization milestone (VAL-COMBO-001) - MTP should be disabled in the production config.
